operations.name: list_packs
operations.description: List the data packs (domains) and whether each is loaded on this OmniGate. Use before asking, to choose a workspace.

operations.name: ask
operations.description: Ask a question in plain English in one pack (workspace). Returns the answer, rows, SQL and an evidence block saying what it was answered from and how the scope was applied.

workspaceId.description: A pack id from list_packs, or null for all data.

operations.name: get_decisions
operations.description: Read the hash-chained decision record for one workflow run and whether the chain verifies. Needs the decision file to be shared with the layer.

operations.name: status
operations.description: Layer and OmniGate status: reachability, whether workflows are available, whether decisions can be read.

operations.name: list_adapters
operations.description: List the upload adapters (what file types can be brought in, whether each is enabled, and its licence flags such as non-commercial).

operations.name: list_uploads
operations.description: List the caller's own upload records (private to them, they expire).

operations.name: upload_file
operations.description: Upload a file (raw body, query name and workspaceId) for an enabled adapter to ingest; returns an upload record (derived result, notes, licence, ask prompts). The file itself is not kept. Needs the user's upload grant.

operations.name: list_workflow_definitions
operations.description: Workflow definitions the caller may start or approve (needs the Server's commercial edition and a workflow grant; answers 404 workflows_off otherwise).

operations.name: list_workflows
operations.description: Runs waiting for the caller's approval. Read-only: approving is deliberately never a tool.

operations.name: get_workflow_run
operations.description: One workflow run: stage, rules, evidence, AI recommendation, approvals and the payload hash. Visible only if the Server lets the caller see it.

operations.name: start_workflow
operations.description: Start a run for an entity key (needs canStartWorkflows). Not a tool: starting creates a record that people must then approve, so it stays a human action in a person's session.

operations.name: approve_workflow
operations.description: Approve a run, bound to its payload hash (needs canApprove; the Server refuses the initiator, non-human identities, a repeat and a stale hash). Never a tool.

operations.name: reject_workflow
operations.description: Reject a run with a reason (needs canApprove, or be the initiator withdrawing). Never a tool.

evidence.note: Server limits a Workspace by data source, not schema (Server#109). 'server-backends' means a Workspace named for the pack exists; 'agency-hint' means the layer added the pack's data sets to the question; 'none' means the question was asked in All data.
